cross_market_insights: Sydney and Melbourne SERPs are near-identical and transactional: airline and retailer package catalogues (Qantas, Flight Centre, Jetstar, Couples Getaways) plus a gifting marketplace (RedBalloon). Nobody explains what an anniversary package actually includes, what it leaves out, or when a tailored trip beats a catalogue bundle.
Brisbane and Perth SERPs are weak: a Facebook thread and a budget finance blog rank top 3 in Brisbane, and a parked for-sale domain ranks #1 in Perth. Quality bar is low outside Sydney and Melbourne.
Every ranking package page is domestic or price-led (from AUD 485pp, budget blogs). None speaks to a 150K+ couple planning an international milestone trip with private moments built in.
No result names the anniversary at all beyond a passing mention; no result ties the trip to the milestone (10th, 25th, 50th) or to a vow renewal or private dinner on the trip.
AI Overview sits at position 1 in all four cities, so a clear, quotable definition of what an anniversary trip package includes and a scannable checklist earn the best chance of citation.
Volumes are tiny (10 to 70 a month nationally) and competition is high on paid; the value is commercial intent and fit with /destination-packages and /travel, not traffic.

PAA asks 'where to go for an anniversary' and 'best anniversary trip'; our live /celebration-ideas/anniversary-trip-ideas and /expert-advice/where-do-you-hold-an-anniversary-party already answer the ideas side, so this piece must stay on the package and booking side.
payload.recommended_angle: The buyer's guide the SERP is missing: what a luxury anniversary trip package should include for a couple marking a milestone, how to tell a catalogue bundle from a tailored package, and what a Wedded Advisor arranges behind it (flights and transfers, room category, the private dinner or vow moment, timing around the date, travel privileges at partner properties).
